categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the research, production, and sales of aromatic ketone products, including specialty engineering plastics core raw materials, photoinitiators, cosmetic raw materials, and pharmaceutical and pesticide intermediates. Key product lines include DFBP for PEEK production, photoinitiators like MBP, PBZ, ITF for UV coatings and inks, and functional cosmetic ingredients such as HAP and HDO.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes Friedel-Crafts (F-C) acylation reaction technology and has developed proprietary catalytic and purification technologies to produce high-purity aromatic ketones. It employs industrial-scale production with patented processes focusing on atom economy, environmental protection, and automation. The company also innovates in polymer monomer purification and non-toxic, efficient cosmetic raw material production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global and domestic leading chemical companies such as SYENSQO, VICTREX, EVONIK, IGM, SYMRISE, Zhongyan Co., and Hanghua Co. The products serve industries like specialty engineering plastics (PEEK manufacturers), UV-curable coatings and inks, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, and agrochemicals. Major end markets include aerospace, automotive, IT manufacturing, medical devices, packaging, and personal care.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic sales and exports accounting for about 30% of revenue. Export markets include Europe, the Americas, India, Japan, and South Korea. The company is headquartered in Nanjing Chemical Industrial Park, Jiangsu Province, China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream and midstream in the chemical supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of specialty chemical raw materials and intermediates used by downstream manufacturers of engineering plastics, UV materials, and cosmetics.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding production capacity, optimizing product structure, and deepening cooperation with downstream customers and research institutes. R&D focuses on improving production efficiency, developing new high-purity products, and innovating in specialty engineering plastics and cosmetic raw materials. The company plans to enhance technology absorption, innovation, and industry-academia collaboration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of specialty chemical products including aromatic ketones, photoinitiators, and cosmetic raw materials. The company uses a direct sales model with contracts and orders from industrial customers domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include global leaders like VICTREX, SYENSQO, EVONIK, and domestic companies such as Zhongyan Co. and Pengfulong. The company is positioned as a leading domestic producer with recognized high-quality products and stable relationships with top global customers, leveraging proprietary technologies and expanding capacity to strengthen its market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 419.46 million, a slight decrease of 3.66% from 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 55.97 million, down 40.04%. The company has total assets of about RMB 1.25 billion and equity of RMB 1.15 billion, with ongoing capacity expansion projects. Sales volume increased by over 30%, indicating growth in market demand despite pricing pressures.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high product purity, stable quality, and cost-effective, environmentally friendly production processes. Its aromatic ketone products are recognized for enabling higher-specification PEEK materials and advanced cosmetic ingredients. The company’s flexible production lines and strong R&D capabilities allow it to meet diverse customer needs and maintain long-term partnerships with leading global chemical firms.
